questions.q: About how many mantissa bits does fp16 keep?
questions.why: fp16 has 10 mantissa bits, about three decimal digits. It is not 15 or 16 digits.

options: 0.0001 is less than half the gap between numbers near 1
Addition is not defined for fp16
It is a bug in PyTorch
questions.answer: 0.0001 is less than half the gap between numbers near 1
questions.why: The gap near 1 is 2^-10, about 0.001, and half of that is larger than 0.0001.

questions.q: In the lab an fp16 running sum of 0.0001 stalls at 0.25. Why there?
options: Above 0.25, half the gap is larger than what is being added
questions.answer: Above 0.25, half the gap is larger than what is being added
questions.why: The gap doubles at each power of two, and at 0.25 half of it reaches 0.000122.

questions.q: Where is a long sum hidden in every linear layer?
options: In each dot product of the matmul
questions.answer: In each dot product of the matmul
questions.why: Each output is a sum of many products. --fast fp16_accumulation changes how that sum is carried.
